goal: Recover and preserve inactive VII businesses as accurate indexable canonical pages while excluding them from active discovery, retaining all data for supplier-driven reactivation, and publishing the verified cumulative release.

intent_model.literal_request: Turn the 405 base-mapped 410 business URLs into inactive business pages, remove phone and WhatsApp, keep them indexable and manageable, preserve their data and allow a one-click return to advertising.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Temporary advertising pauses never destroy SEO equity or business data, and neither visitors nor search engines receive stale commercial claims.
likely_rejections: Admin cannot restore a returning business

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Classify and process the complete 405-row legacy-gone family, not only the two already known active mismatches.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: A reconciliation ledger must account for every row as active redirect, inactive archive redirect, or evidenced true removal.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Provide one administration action that verifies current supplier truth and completes reactivation without rebuilding content.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: The persisted status transition and public/search reflection must be tested from inactive through active.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Return a substantive 200 canonical page with index,follow and appropriate sitemap treatment, not a soft 404 or noindex page.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Live response, canonical, robots and structured data must agree with the inactive content.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: An inactive business is preserved but clearly unavailable.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Distinguish inactive from permanently removed using supplier truth and recovered identity.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Visitors choose an active alternative; an operator rechecks and reactivates a returning supplier.
deferred_complexity: Manual content enrichment unrelated to recovered data

natural_destination: Legacy VII URLs, canonical place pages, search and map results, XML sitemaps, supplier persistence and the VII administration interface.

facts.claim: The bundled legacy inventory contains 405 gone paths, including recoverable business paths.
The current sync filters active=false records before generation persistence.
The current business detail resolvers read active public snapshots and return notFound when absent.

assumptions.claim: A recoverable old page exposes enough stable identity and content to build an inactive archive row.
assumptions.validation: Parse the old page site ID, canonical path, title, description and media and reconcile it to supplier/world identity.

assumptions.claim: All four worlds can share one lifecycle contract while retaining their own canonical routes.
assumptions.validation: Run fixtures and route tests for vacation, event, spa and hourly IDs.

in_scope: admin inactive inventory and verified reactivation
out_of_scope: Manually forcing an inactive supplier into active advertising
invariants: Active businesses keep full current behavior
Inactive businesses never appear as bookable or contactable
Unknown unrecoverable identities do not receive fabricated pages
Existing cumulative fixes remain in the release
affected_family: vacation supplier lifecycle and /business detail route
event supplier lifecycle and /events/place detail route
spa supplier lifecycle and /discover/place/spa detail route
hourly supplier lifecycle and /discover/place/hourly detail route
public search, map, slider and recommendation exclusion queries
legacy redirect inventory and Worker disposition
XML sitemap, canonical, robots and structured-data generators
inactive-business administration list and reactivation action
supplier sync migration and D1 archive persistence
cumulative VII production release and rollback pipeline

requirements.statement: Every recoverable legacy business receives a stable canonical inactive page and one-hop legacy redirect.
Inactive public pages are indexable and substantive but expose no phone, WhatsApp, booking, availability, price or offer claims.
Inactive businesses are excluded from all active discovery surfaces.
requirements.source: User request and VII product truth

requirements.statement: All recoverable data and supplier identity persist for a future return.
Admin shows inactive records and provides a one-action supplier-verified reactivation path that persists and is audited.
The complete 405-row legacy disposition is reconciled and only truly unrecoverable or permanently removed paths remain 410.
The exact cumulative candidate is published with rollback and live desktop, mobile, SEO and admin evidence.

acceptance_checks.setup: A recovered inactive vacation record and its old path
acceptance_checks.action: Request the old URL and follow its redirect on desktop and mobile
acceptance_checks.observable_result: One 301 leads to a 200 canonical index,follow page showing 'ירד מפרסום' with preserved identity/media and no contact or commerce actions.

acceptance_checks.setup: An inactive record containing historic contact and offer data in private archive storage
acceptance_checks.action: Render public HTML, hydrate it and query every discovery surface
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No phone, WhatsApp, booking, availability, price or Offer JSON-LD leaks and the ID is absent from search, map, rails and recommendations.

acceptance_checks.setup: An inactive supplier record visible in admin
acceptance_checks.action: Reload without cache and re-read the persisted record
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Status, public URL, preserved data counts and lifecycle timestamps remain unchanged and an audit record exists.

acceptance_checks.setup: The supplier fixture changes the same world and ID from inactive to active
acceptance_checks.action: Run the verified reactivation action and the normal sync
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The canonical page becomes the full active page, discovery inclusion returns and archived media/metadata are not lost or duplicated.
The system refuses advertising activation, keeps the archive page and records the reason without changing public discovery.

acceptance_checks.action: Run reconciliation against old-page recovery, active catalog and persisted inactive archive
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Every row has one explicit evidenced disposition and no recoverable identity remains in the unexplained 410 bucket.

acceptance_checks.setup: A frozen clean cumulative release candidate with recorded current production identity
acceptance_checks.action: Run release gates, deploy once and execute representative live scenarios
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Live build identity matches the candidate, critical routes and admin pass, and a tested rollback target is recorded.

acceptance_checks.setup: A cold-cache legacy or canonical request after deployment
acceptance_checks.action: Load once, reload and revisit from an active search page
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No transient 404/410, generic redirect, stale CTA, hydration error or contradictory robots state appears.

authorization_boundary: The user authorized implementation and public deployment of the completed verified cumulative VII release. No invented identities, unsafe forced activation, credential disclosure or repeated uncertain deploy is authorized.
